purpose: Teach: クリティカル/全会/総局/複写/扶桑社/スポークスマン/図版/中味

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、クリティカルな経営判断を下す時期だ
lines.en: We're at a critical juncture for this company. The decisions we make now will shape everything ahead.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Slight pause after the first sentence—letting it land. Calm conviction, no hurry. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。取締役会全会一致で承認されました
lines.en: Yes, sir. The board approved it unanimously.
lines.style: Formal, attentive. Crisp confirmation—no embellishment. Steady eye contact. The voice of someone reporting upward with confidence in the news they're delivering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外総局との連携を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our ties with the overseas divisions. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Direct command, but not harsh. Weight on 'ties' and 'non-negotiable.' Expectation baked in—he's not asking, he's directing. Brief, economical.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。書類の複写は最小限に抑えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll keep documentation lean and efficient.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgement. Business-like. He's already moving to the next task in his mind while he's speaking. Competent, no wasted motion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、扶桑社系のメディアと交流しろ
lines.en: Make sure we're engaging with Fusosha's media outlets. Active presence.
lines.style: Another instruction delivered with the same economical weight. Slight emphasis on 'active'—it's not passive observation, it's a push. Clear expectation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新スポークスマンを選任しました
lines.en: Done. We've already brought on a new spokesperson.
lines.style: Efficient update—proving action before being asked for it. Tone suggests he's ahead of the curve. Brief, confident. The ease of someone who knows his boss appreciates speed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: カタログの図版を充実させろ
lines.en: Beef up the visuals in the catalog. Make it stand out.
lines.style: Short, pointed directive. Slight energy shift—this one's about execution and presentation. Conversational but still unmistakably an order.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プレスリリースの中味を精査します
lines.en: Yes. I'll review the press release copy thoroughly before it goes out.
lines.style: Final confirmation—voice tightens slightly, careful precision. He's closing the loop, showing due diligence on the details. Steady, professional finish.
